scope: Node-only editor contract; no live AE.

results.name: Read binds an immutable snapshot to the selected tool instance
Apply sends the bound identity and old snapshot and preflights at original insert time
Switching comp or clearing the editor prevents sending an update
Unavailable source version and manual modifications cannot become editable
A timeout clears editable state and cannot cause an automatic write retry
Clearing the editor during preflight stops the queued write
